name: Knock CRM
positioning: Front-office leasing platform for multifamily: self-scheduled tours, unified prospect messaging, source attribution and team performance oversight.
description: Knock CRM is a leasing customer-relationship platform for multifamily owners and operators, now published by RealPage. It groups tour scheduling, marketing attribution, prospect messaging, task management, visitor experience and team oversight into one front-office suite. Knock Now lets a prospective renter self-schedule a tour from any website or app. Messaging brings email, text, voice and chat into a single screen. Source attribution ties each lead back to the marketing channel that produced it and drives automated campaigns. Benchmarking and performance trends give leasing leadership visibility into individual and team activity. The vendor also offers AI solutions, advanced analytics and a data cloud with API access alongside the core CRM.
real_estate_use: A leasing team at a large apartment community loses prospects between the first inquiry and the tour. With Knock the renter books their own slot straight from the property website, so nobody waits for a callback, and every subsequent exchange — text, email, call, chat — lands in one inbox where any agent on shift can pick it up. The regional marketer looks at source attribution to see which portal or campaign is actually filling the calendar and cuts the ones that are not. The leasing director uses the benchmarking view to compare conversion across communities and to see which agents let follow-ups lapse.
features: Self-scheduled tours from any property website or app
Unified inbox across email, text, voice and chat
Marketing source attribution and automated campaigns
Task management for follow-up on open prospects
Leasing team benchmarking and performance trends
Data cloud and API access for reporting

use_cases.job: Let prospective renters book their own tours and keep every follow-up in one shared inbox
Attribute each lead to its marketing channel and stop funding the ones that do not convert
Compare leasing conversion and team activity across communities in one benchmarking view

integrations: Partner directory published by the vendor
